requirements.text: Visited links shall be recorded to the Global History.
The correct link shall be recorded to the Global History after a server redirect.
Clicking on a history link shall cause it to be launched in a browser window.
A History entry shall be deleted.
Multiple History entries shall be deleted and no longer be displayed.
History items shall be grouped by Day / Site / None.
History shall be sorted and reverse-sorted per column.
History columns shall be resizable to show/hide more of entries.
History colmns shall be shown and hidden.
Recently visited sites shall be re-visited via Back and Forward button dropdown menu.
A new, empty session history file shall be created for a new browser window or a restart.

generated_cases.title: Normal recording of visited links to Global History
generated_cases.description: Visit a standard web link and verify that the link is successfully recorded in the Global History.

generated_cases.title: Edge case for visiting empty URL or malformed link
generated_cases.description: Attempt to visit an empty URL or malformed link and verify the Global History handling.

generated_cases.title: Abnormal history database write failure
generated_cases.description: Trigger a scenario where the history database encounters a write failure during link recording and verify error handling.

generated_cases.title: Record correct link after server redirect (Normal)
generated_cases.description: Verify that when a user navigates to a link that triggers a server redirect, the final target URL is correctly recorded to the Global History rather than the intermediate redirect URL.

generated_cases.title: Record correct link after a chain of multiple redirects (Edge)
generated_cases.description: Verify that when a link triggers a chain of multiple consecutive server redirects, the final destination URL is accurately captured and recorded in the Global History.

generated_cases.title: Handle redirect loop error during history recording (Abnormal)
generated_cases.description: Verify the system behavior and error handling when a server redirect results in an infinite redirect loop, ensuring the history recording gracefully handles the termination.

generated_cases.title: Normal Launch of History Link
generated_cases.description: Clicking on a valid history link causes it to be successfully launched in a browser window.

generated_cases.title: Edge Case Launch While Offline
generated_cases.description: Clicking on a history link while the browser is offline attempts to launch it with appropriate offline handling.

generated_cases.title: Abnormal Invalid URL Schema or Missing Target
generated_cases.description: Attempting to launch a history link with an invalid URL schema or missing target gracefully handles the error without crashing.

generated_cases.title: Delete single history entry - Normal
generated_cases.description: Verify that a single History entry is successfully deleted when requested by the user.

generated_cases.title: Delete already deleted entry - Edge
generated_cases.description: Verify the system behavior when attempting to delete an entry that has already been deleted.

generated_cases.title: Delete operation failure due to locked database - Error
generated_cases.description: Verify the error handling when the delete operation fails due to a locked history database.

generated_cases.title: Delete Multiple History Entries
generated_cases.description: Select multiple history entries and delete them simultaneously to verify they are removed from the display.

generated_cases.title: Delete All History Entries
generated_cases.description: Select all history entries across the list and perform a bulk deletion to verify complete removal.

generated_cases.title: Partial Deletion Failure
generated_cases.description: Attempt to delete multiple history entries when a storage or write error occurs mid-operation, and verify error handling.

generated_cases.title: Clear Global History Normal
generated_cases.description: Clear the entire Global History successfully and verify all entries are removed.

generated_cases.title: Clear Global History Edge
generated_cases.description: Attempt to clear the Global History when the history is already completely empty.

generated_cases.title: Clear Global History Abnormal
generated_cases.description: Handle a database or system failure gracefully during the Global History wipe operation.

generated_cases.title: Group history items by Day, Site, and None
generated_cases.description: Verify that history items can be successfully grouped by Day, Site, and None according to user selection.

generated_cases.title: Group history with empty data set
generated_cases.description: Verify the grouping behavior when the history data set is completely empty.

generated_cases.title: Grouping failure on corrupted entries
generated_cases.description: Verify system error handling when attempting to group history items containing corrupted entry metadata.

generated_cases.title: Sort and reverse-sort history columns normally
generated_cases.description: Verify that history items can be sorted and reverse-sorted per column as expected.

generated_cases.title: Sort empty history table
generated_cases.description: Verify sorting behavior when the history table contains no entries.

generated_cases.title: Sort failure handling on mismatched data types
generated_cases.description: Verify the system handles and reports an error or fails gracefully during a sort operation on mismatched data types.

generated_cases.title: Normal Resize of History Columns
generated_cases.description: Resize history columns to show or hide more of the entries and verify correct layout rendering.

generated_cases.title: Edge Resize of History Columns
generated_cases.description: Resize history columns to their minimum or maximum width limits and verify boundary constraints.

generated_cases.title: Abnormal Resize Layout Handling
generated_cases.description: Verify handling when an extreme column resize operation encounters a rendering crash or layout failure.

generated_cases.title: Show and Hide History Columns Normally
generated_cases.description: Verify that history columns can be successfully shown and hidden via the user interface.

generated_cases.title: Hide All History Columns
generated_cases.description: Verify the edge scenario of hiding all available history columns simultaneously.

generated_cases.title: Failure to Persist Column Visibility State
generated_cases.description: Verify system behavior when saving or persisting the column visibility state encounters an abnormal failure.

generated_cases.title: Revisit recent sites via Back and Forward dropdown menu
generated_cases.description: Verify that recently visited sites can be successfully revisited by selecting them from the Back and Forward button dropdown menus under normal navigation conditions.

generated_cases.title: Back and Forward dropdown menu when no history exists
generated_cases.description: Verify the behavior of the Back and Forward button dropdown menus when there is no prior navigation history (edge condition).

generated_cases.title: Back and Forward dropdown menu failure handling
generated_cases.description: Verify system behavior and error handling when attempting to use the Back and Forward dropdown menus while the navigation state is corrupt (abnormal condition).

generated_cases.title: Create New Empty Session History File Normally
generated_cases.description: Verify that a new, empty session history file is successfully created when a new browser window is opened or the browser is restarted.

generated_cases.title: Create Session History File with Restricted Permissions
generated_cases.description: Verify session history file creation behavior when file system permissions are restricted for the directory.

generated_cases.title: Disk Full Error During Session File Creation
generated_cases.description: Verify error handling when a disk full error occurs while attempting to create a new session history file.

reference_cases.title: TC-073
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Go|History.
2. Observe the contents of the Global History Window.
3. Quit and restart the browser.
4. Select Go|History.

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. If you've observed the initial conditions, the History window should be non-empty upon first observation.
2. After restart, the History window should still be non-empty.

reference_cases.title: TC-076
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Go|History.
2. Select (highlight) a history entry, press the delete key, OR
3. Select (highlight) a history entry, Select Edit|Delete.
4. Restart the browser.

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. After step(3) the title of and link to the history entry should now be removed from the history window.
2. After step(4) it should still be gone.

4. Restart the browser. Select Go|History

2. After step(4) they should still be gone.

reference_cases.title: TC-078
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Go|History.
2. Observe the contents of the Global History Window.
3. Select Edit|Preferences (from a navigator window)
4. Browse to the Navigator|History Panel.
5. Under "Browsing History" click the "Clear History" button.
6. Return to observe the contents of the Global History Window.

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. If you've observed the initial conditions, the History window should be non-empty upon first observation.
2. After pressing the button, the history window should be empty of individual history items.

reference_cases.title: TC-079
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Go|History.
2. In the Global History window, select View|Group By|Day.
3. In the Global History window, select View|Group By|Site.
4. In the Global History window, select View|Group By|None.

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. After Step(2), history entries should appear grouped into folders labeled "Today", "Yesterday", "2 days ago", ... ,"6 days ago", and "Older than 6 days".
2. After Step(3), the history items should appear grouped by domain name (no folders).
3. After Sep (4), the history items should appear

reference_cases.title: TC-080
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
Select Go|History. This is most easily tested by using the View|Group By|None setting but not strictly necessary.
1. Click on the "Title" column once.
2. Click on the "Title" column a second time.
3. Click on the "Title" column a third time.
4. Click on the "Location" column once, and a second time.
5. Click on the "Last Visited" column once, and a second time.

EXPECTED RESULTS
By step:
1. The bookmarks should sort into alphabetical order, by Title.
2. The bookmarks should sort into reverse-alphabetical order, by Title.
3. The bookmarks should sort into "natural" order (the way they were originally sorted).
4. The bookmarks should sort into order by Location and then the reverse of that order.
5. The bookmarks should sort into order by Last Visited and then the reverse of that order.

reference_cases.title: TC-081
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Go|History.
2. Mouseover the separator between the "Name" and "URL" columns.
3. Click and drag that separator to the left and right.
4. Repeat this with each of the other column separators.

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. In step(2) the mouse pointer should change to a double-arrowed icon(platform specific or XP?).
2. In step(3) the column sizes on either side of the separator should shrink and grow as you drag. The content of the column should move with the column header. Column content that is obscured should be replaced by the ellipsis(?).

reference_cases.title: TC-082
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. You must have used the installation of the browser you plan to test.
2. If you have not, browse around some, then come back. Or run the gomenu-list test first.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Select Go|History.
2. Click the icon on the far right of the column headers.
3. Uncheck two of the items (columns).
4. Recheck an item.
5. Quit and restart the application.

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. Step(2) a popup menu should appear listing all of the column headers as menuitems.
2. Step(3), they should all be checked by default and unchecking should cause that column to disappear from the manage bookmarks window.
3. Step(4), the columns should reappear upon rechecking its name on the list.
4. Step(5) the columns should appear just as the did after step(4).

reference_cases.title: TC-083
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
1. Your session history needs to be empty for this test so restart the browser or open a new window. To check, the Back/Forward buttons should be inactive and the dropdowns should not appear at all when the session history is empty.

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Follow this Netscape link.
2. Follow this Netscape People link.
3. Wait for the redirect (15sec).
4. Follow this Mozilla QA link.
5. Follow this Mozilla link.
6. From the "Back" button dropdown select the 4th item from the top "Netscape.com".
7. From the "Forward" button dropdown select the 3rd item from the top "Mozilla QA Home Page"

EXPECTED RESULTS
1. For Step(6), the dropdown menu should be apparent and active, the 4th item should be "Netscape.com", the page title, and selecting it should actually load that page
2. For Step(7), the dropdown menu should be apparent and active, the 3rd item should be "Mozilla QA Home Page", the page title, and selecting it should actually load that page.
